capabilities: Sync the vault across desktop and Android via Git or GitHub API
Pull remote changes, push local edits, and detect local changes in one command
Schedule auto-sync and sync on startup
Report desktop conflicts in a generated Markdown file
Customize repository URL, branch, and commit message template
disambiguation: Not a note-moving or organizing tool; the name refers to syncing notes between devices.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Mobile sync only supports GitHub; desktop supports any Git remote (GitLab, Gitea).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in Git-based sync, and Android lacks local Git, so keeping a vault consistent across desktop and mobile is hard without a paid service.

relations.evidence: obsidian-git — The inspiration behind this plugin.

summary: Cross-device vault sync that uses system Git on desktop and the GitHub API on Android, with one-click, startup and scheduled syncing.
